scientific_integrity: A global sign and uniqueness classification is proved analytically, with 847 deterministic supporting assertions. Prior exact stationary covariance and MSD equations are credited; direct derivability from those formulas and unindexed equivalent work remain originality risks. No independent validation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Stationary two-layer Gaussian OU with 0<gamma2<gamma1, D1,D2>0 only; exact local MSD slope rather than finite-window exponent; no elementary closed formula for the unique slope-crossing time; full covariance and MSD pre-exist in the cited papers.
title: Two sharp thresholds separating anticorrelation from local subdiffusion in hierarchical Ornstein–Uhlenbeck transport
